context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about business basics
purpose: Teach: キャンセル/器具/儲かる/スクリプト/ゲート/実例/使い勝手/成り立た

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 商売は、ゲートをくぐる客の動きを掴むことだ。
lines.en: Business is about understanding how customers move through the entrance.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried delivery. Slight pause after each phrase, like settling a principle into place. Low register, patient. The voice of someone who's watched this for decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しております。スクリプト整備で、若手でも対応できるようにします。
lines.en: Understood. By preparing scripts, even the younger staff can handle this.
lines.style: Respectful but not deferential. Calm nod in the voice. Each word deliberate — showing he has listened and already begun to act on it. Steady eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 器具の使い勝手、製品価値の半分を占める。
lines.en: How easily someone can use a tool—that's half the product's value.
lines.style: Quiet weight on each word. Not lecturing; stating something observed. Slight lean forward in tone. A pause before 'value' — giving it room to land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。儲かる仕組みが成り立たない時こそ、原点に戻ります。
lines.en: Yes. When the profit mechanism breaks, that's when I go back to the beginning.
lines.style: Firm, grounded. The 'yes' is immediate and sure. Pace slightly quickens on 'back to the beginning' — showing resolve, not desperation. Warm underneath the steel.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: キャンセルの実例も、教訓として残しておけ。
lines.en: Keep the cancellation cases. They're lessons.
lines.style: Direct, no softening. Sharp clean attack on the opening. Brief. The tone of someone who doesn't repeat himself. Authority without cruelty — this is how it is done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet, sincere close. Slight catch in the voice — genuine weight, not performative. The kind of promise made to someone whose respect you've earned. Soft landing.
